en: Color postcard showing a broad boulevard and landscaped square in Cluj, with the Orthodox Metropolitan Cathedral on the left, the National Theatre/Opera building with rooftop statues on the right, and 1960s cars on the street. The reverse is in Romanian, with a 40 Bani Poșta Română stamp and a handwritten message dated 18.07.1969. The card is printed with "CLUJ — Piața Victoriei."
